cover.title: Saint Jane
cover.categories: Brand Identity, Design System, Art Direction

header: Luxury skincare deserves more than templates and stock photography. Saint Jane required a design system that rivals heritage beauty brands while remaining distinctly modern. We built a framework rooted in craft, control, and obsessive attention to detail.

layout.title: Defining Modern Luxury
text: The challenge: create a brand that feels expensive without relying on tired luxury tropes. No marble. No gold foil for the sake of gold foil. We focused on precision. Every element earns its place. The metallic label plaques became the signature detail: a physical marker of quality that translates across every touchpoint.

layout.title: Color and Efficacy
text: The color system balances restraint and personality. Sage green anchors the brand in natural efficacy. Vibrant pink and yellow provide energy without sacrificing sophistication. The extended scales and neutral palette give the system range from packaging to digital experiences and editorial applications.

layout.title: System Components
text: We designed UI components with the same rigor as the product packaging. Form states, toggles, and inputs reflect a commitment to thoughtful design. Nothing feels like an afterthought. The interface is as polished as the brand itself.

layout.title: 3D Strategy & Testing
text: We rendered every product shot in 3D to maintain complete control over lighting, composition, and context. Beyond the aesthetic, this was a strategic choice for iterative experimentation. By building these assets in a 3D environment, we were able to rapidly test and deploy dozens of visual variations for digital ads. This 'data-driven design' approach allowed us to identify which compositions drove the highest engagement, directly increasing ad effectiveness without the cost of a traditional reshoot.

layout.title: Precision Typography
text: The typography system pairs the refined elegance of PP Eiko with the clean functionality of Basis Grotesque. Display treatments remain intentionally restrained. The hierarchy works without shouting. Every size, weight, and spacing decision reinforces the premium positioning.

layout.title: The Result
text: The result is a design system that works as hard as the products themselves. It scales with the brand. It maintains quality at every touchpoint. We built this for a beauty brand that refuses to cut corners.
